subject.title: File Browser: Remove ALLOWED_FILE_NAMES whitelist, add scope levels

question: Should OpenClaw support Control UI workspace mutation and host-system file browsing, or narrow this request to the already-merged read-only workspace browse boundary?
rationale: The request crosses from safe bootstrap-file editing into arbitrary workspace and host filesystem access, which is a maintainer security/product boundary rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Narrow to read-only workspace browsing
options.body: Keep allowlisted writes, build UI browsing on `agents.workspace.list/get`, and leave write/delete/upload plus host-system browsing out until separately approved.

options.title: Sponsor workspace CRUD only
options.body: Advance https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61368 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/62417 after security proof for workspace-only mutation, while rejecting host-system scope for now.

options.title: Approve a system-scope design
options.body: Define an explicit operator-controlled host filesystem mode with separate permissioning, audit, read-only defaults, and proof before implementation.

recommendation.title: Narrow to read-only workspace browsing
recommendation.body: Keep allowlisted writes, build UI browsing on `agents.workspace.list/get`, and leave write/delete/upload plus host-system browsing out until separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current read-only workspace API boundary and mobile file-browser direction, making them the best available routing owner for the scope decision.
